messages:
jamal: Planning deploy for rc-2 today at 17:00 UTC. Need confirmation from CS & Marketing for release notes + smoke ownership.
olivia: 17:00 UTC works for marketing. I'll have social copy ready by 16:30 UTC. Can you paste final highlights?
cs_lead: I'll own KB update and support standby. Need rollback steps + expected user impact.
simon: Oncall here — I'll run smoke checks and watch latency dashboards. Who's doing embed verification?
jamal: No schema changes. Embedding model bumped in hosted only. Rollback = flip `feature_flag_rc2` off + scale down new replicas. Minimal user impact.
mike: I'll coordinate cutover and be primary comms during window. Deploy window 17:00-17:15 UTC. Rollback window until 17:25 UTC.
product-bot: Draft release notes saved: https://internal/docs/releases/rc-2-draft — please review.
elaine: Quick Q — is there a change to embedding model endpoint path? Any client opt-in required?
jamal: Endpoint unchanged. Model param `model=embed-v2` is the only change. No client code changes needed unless they pin model. Cost ~+5% per-embed.
cs_lead: KB snippet plan: 1) What changed 2) How to opt-out 3) Known issues. Will post draft by 16:45 UTC.
jamal: Smoke checklist (please sign off):
```
- smoke:health: curl -sSf https://api.redwood.dev/health -> 200
- smoke:generate: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' | jq .status == "ok"
- smoke:embed: run /tools/embed-test.sh --model embed-v2 -> verify sample latencies <200ms
- monitor: dashboard: /dashboards/realtime-latency and /dashboards/embed-qc
- fallback: set `model_fallback=embed-v1` via admin UI and confirm traffic shifts
```
olivia: Marketing assets: blog + banner ready. Waiting on final bullets.
simon: I'll own `smoke:health` and `smoke:generate`. Jamal can you own `smoke:embed`?
jamal: Yep, I'll run embed tests and post results here.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z -> production by mike. CI checks passed.
jamal: Embed test results: sample latency median 42ms, p95 120ms, quality sanity checks pass on our prompt set. No regressions observed.
cs_lead: OK from support. Oncall contact simon. KB draft posted: https://internal/kb/rc-2
olivia: Marketing OK. Assets scheduled. Social/tweet scheduled for 17:30 UTC.
mike: All set. Starting deploy in 5m. Please be on standby in #eng-releases.
simon: watching dashboards now :eyes:
jamal: Deploy successful. Post-deploy smoke all green. Closing thread."
